title: SR-6.11 One product site
request: Closes G102: the seed-stage analysis (B9, B10). The product repository still holds the older template site (site/: web/, landing/, build.mjs, DEPLOY.md), whose pages carry titles and taglines of their own (site/web/business.html) beside the README's line and the deployed site's, and whose guard against certification, uptime and SLA claims (test/deploy-docs.test.mjs) checks pages no visitor sees. QL-1.06 runs the claims check over site/**/*.html, so the template is checked while the deployed site is not. Repository: memev. Depends on contracts: SR-5.04, SR-6.10, QL-1.06. The template's own guard is test/site.test.mjs:256-269; test/deploy-docs.test.mjs guards memev's shipped deployment docs and stays as it is.

tasks.title: The template site is retired and its guard lives on where visitors are
requirements: the certification, uptime and SLA guard runs in memev-site's CI first (SR-6.10 task 2), and the change note names the memev-site commit and the CI run that show it

site/ is removed from the product repository, with the tests that only read it; nothing in memev's docs, tests, workflows or scripts refers to it afterwards, and the claims step no longer globs site/**/*.html
pages the template held that the deployed site lacks are listed in the change note for the site's owner; none is copied here
the README's tagline is the status table's positioning entry (SR-5.04), so the product repository states one line
test/deploy-docs.test.mjs, which guards memev's own shipped deployment docs, is not changed
package.json's description is the same one line as the README's tagline
no tracked file is a copy of a template page, and the template's pages are not moved elsewhere in the repository

criteria.statement: SR-6.11 retired: site/ does not exist, every workflow glob and docs link resolves to a file that exists, and no file outside changelog.d refers to site/web, site/landing or site/build.mjs; on the base tree the test fails

verifier.cmd: out=$(node --test --test-reporter=tap --test-name-pattern='^SR-6.11 retired' test/site-retired.test.mjs 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | tail -30; [ $rc -eq 0 ] && printf '%s\n' "$out" | awk -v pat='^SR-6.11 retired$' 'BEGIN { n = split(pat, alt, "|") } function flush(  i) { if (cand != "") for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (cand ~ alt[i]) hit[i] = 1; cand = "" } /^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - / { flush(); name = $0; sub(/^[[:space:]]*(not )?ok [0-9]+ - /, "", name); if ($0 ~ /^[[:space:]]*ok / && name !~ /# (SKIP|TODO)/ && name !~ /\.test\.m?js$/) cand = name; next } /^[[:space:]]*type: .suite./ { cand = "" } END { flush(); for (i = 1; i <= n; i++) if (!hit[i]) exit 1; exit 0 }'

criteria.statement: The change note names the memev-site commit and CI run that carry the guard

The change note names a full 40-hex memev-site commit and a github.com/<owner>/memev-site/actions/runs/<id> URL. The run is memev-site's, its head_sha equals that commit, its conclusion is success, and it has a step whose name names the certification/uptime/SLA guard and whose conclusion is success (not skipped). This needs a gh token that can read memev-site; if the gate cannot hold one, the fallback is a sequencing gate that requires SR-6.10's signed contract under contracts/signed/. The fallback proves that SR-6.10 passed, not that the guard still runs.

verifier.cmd: n=changelog.d/SR-6.11.md; c=$(grep -oE 'memev-site [0-9a-f]{40}' "$n" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2); u=$(grep -oE 'github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/memev-site/actions/runs/[0-9]+' "$n" | head -1); [ -n "$c" ] && [ -n "$u" ] || exit 1; repo=$(printf '%s' "$u" | cut -d/ -f2-3); id=${u##*/}; gh api "repos/$repo/actions/runs/$id" --jq '.head_sha + " " + .conclusion' | grep -qx "$c success" || exit 1; gh api "repos/$repo/actions/runs/$id/jobs" --jq '.jobs[].steps[] | select(.name | test("certif|uptime|SLA"; "i")) | .conclusion' | grep -qx success

criteria.statement: Subtest 'SR-6.11 claims step' parses .github/workflows/ci.yml and finds the step whose run: calls node scripts/gate/claims.mjs. Its job's and step's if: admit both pull_request and schedule. Its run text names README.md and 'docs/**/*.md' and contains no 'site/'. The subtest executes that run text verbatim with --json via bash -e -c (globstar off), and asserts exit 0 and that 'files' equals the line count of git ls-files ':(glob)README.md' ':(glob)docs/**/*.md', which must be above 0. Red at 30037c3 because there is no claims step; red after QL-1.06 because the step globs site/**/*.html.

criteria.statement: Independent of the implementer's test, with the exclusions pinned in the criterion: no tracked file outside changelog.d/, contracts/ and test/site-retired.test.mjs contains a path segment 'site/' or a quoted 'site' path argument. .github/ is included.
No tracked file is an .html or .htm file, and no tracked blob at HEAD has the same content as any blob under site/ at the recorded base.

verifier.cmd: [ -n "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" ] && [ -z "$(git ls-files '*.html' '*.htm')" ] && b=$(git ls-tree -r "$MEMEV_CONTRACT_BASE" -- site | awk '{print $3}' | sort -u) && [ -n "$b" ] && h=$(git ls-files -s | awk '{print $2}' | sort -u) && [ -z "$({ printf '%s\n' "$b"; printf '%s\n' "$h"; } | sort | uniq -d)" ]

criteria.statement: changelog.d/SR-6.11.md names each template page with no memev-site route: solutions, comparison and quickstart.

verifier.cmd: for p in solutions comparison quickstart; do grep -qiE "(^|[^a-z])$p(\.html)?([^a-z]|$)" changelog.d/SR-6.11.md || { echo "not listed: $p"; exit 1; }; done

criteria.statement: test/deploy-docs.test.mjs is byte-identical to the recorded base (not deleted, the NO_CERT/NO_UPTIME lines at :117-124 intact) and passes on its own.

At the memev-site commit the change note names, the workflow runs node scripts/gate/claims.mjs with --surfaces over the built pages (web/out/**/*.html and landing/out/**/*.html, after npm run build), so copy in .tsx sources is scanned as visitors see it. Residual: this proves the step is present, not that it fails on a planted claim. That stronger red-green belongs in SR-6.10 or QL-1.06, which this contract depends on.

verifier.cmd: n=changelog.d/SR-6.11.md; c=$(grep -oE 'memev-site [0-9a-f]{40}' "$n" | head -1 | cut -d' ' -f2); u=$(grep -oE 'github\.com/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/memev-site/actions/runs/[0-9]+' "$n" | head -1); [ -n "$c" ] && [ -n "$u" ] || exit 1; repo=$(printf '%s' "$u" | cut -d/ -f2-3); id=${u##*/}; gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' "repos/$repo/contents/.github/workflows/ci.yml?ref=$c" | grep -E 'node scripts/gate/claims\.mjs' | grep -qE 'out/\*\*/\*\.html'
